title: Preregistration: revision plan D and journal extension J for Validating LLM User Simulators for Information Cocoon Research
description: Two analysis plans written before any new run. Plan D addresses the review of TCSS-2026-09-1681; Plan J adds EB-NeRD small, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, subcategory metrics and a prompt sensitivity check.
